question: Can the higher-quality outputs of System 2 techniques (intermediate-token reasoning) be distilled back into the same LLM so it answers directly without intermediate tokens, using only unlabeled data?
hypothesis: Self-supervised, consistency-filtered System 2 outputs can be compiled into System 1 generations with better quality than the original System 1 and lower inference cost than System 2.
contributions: Propose System 2 distillation: run a System 2 method on unlabeled inputs, filter by consistency, SFT the same model on final outputs only
Show successful distillation of RaR, S2A and BSM on Llama-2-70B-chat, sometimes beating the System 2 teacher
Show CoT on GSM8K math does not distill

method.summary: Run a System 2 method (RaR, S2A, BSM, CoT) over unlabeled inputs with Llama-2-70B-chat, discard intermediate tokens, keep final outputs that pass a self-consistency filter, then fine-tune the same model on those (input, output) pairs. Compare to System 1 zero-shot, the System 2 method and a System 1 distilled with the same filter.
method.task: Distillation of reasoning/judging procedures into direct answers (symbolic reasoning, sycophancy-robust QA, LLM-as-judge, grade-school math)

datasets.name: Last letter concatenation
datasets.source: constructed by authors from random English words

datasets.name: Coin flip
datasets.source: from Wei et al. 2022 / Deng et al. 2023a task

datasets.name: OASST2 (turn 1, English)
datasets.size: 19,672 train pairs (query plus two responses); valid 273
datasets.split: train for distillation, valid for eval

datasets.name: GSM8k
datasets.size: 7461 [question, answer] pairs distilled from train split
datasets.split: train split as unlabeled; test split eval (size not stated)
datasets.preprocessing: targets are majority vote K=10 of CoT answers with steps removed; target accuracy 56.81% computed for analysis

other.note: System 1 baseline zero-shot, System 2 teacher, and student init; same model in all roles
Universal Self-Consistency prompt picks the majority answer among 20 S2A samples

training.objective: SFT with cross-entropy loss, applied only on the answer part of the sequence
training.steps: RaR last letter 3; RaR coin flip 100; S2A TriviaQA 350; BSM OASST2 600; CoT GSM8K 5000 (Table 5)
training.seeds: 3 random seeds for S2A (Table 2); not stated for others

other.data_filtering: self-consistency of outputs (majority vote, N samples) or under input perturbation (swap response order); examples without agreement discarded

inference.decoding: S2A uses nucleus sampling in both stages; others not stated
inference.samples: RaR: 8 samples (last letter) and 8 per stage (coin flip) for the majority vote; S2A: 20 samples then USC; BSM: each pair evaluated twice (original and swapped order); GSM8k: K=10 majority for distillation data, evaluated with majority voting over k votes (k values in Table 4)
inference.prompting: System 1 is zero-shot with the instruction-tuned model; GSM8k also few (8)-shot with and without CoT

parameters.USC fallback: if 20 answers do not fit context, reduce to 10, else pick randomly

metrics.name: #Tokens
metrics.definition: average number of tokens generated per input over the eval set, intermediate plus final for System 2; for GSM8k summed over all k votes

metrics.name: Agreement
metrics.definition: agreement between model votes and human expert votes (Zheng et al. 2024)

metrics.name: % Inconsistent
metrics.definition: share of examples where the verdict changes when response order is swapped (position bias)

eval.protocol: S2A averaged over 3 random seeds; no seeds, variance or significance tests stated for other tasks; no confidence intervals

prompts.text:
{question}
Based on the information provided in the original query, could you please rephrase it and expand it to help you do better answering. Please ensure that your response solely includes the reformulated question, excluding any introductory phrases or explanatory remarks, while preserving all the details from the original query.

Read the question: {question}. 20 answers have been provided: {answers} Carefully read all answers and compose the final answer such that it is consistent with the majority of variants provided. Provide final answer as "FINAL: <your final answer>

results.claim: Distilled 2-Step RaR reaches 98.0% on last letter concatenation, far above its System 2 teacher.
results.setup: Llama-2-70B-chat, last letter concatenation, 200 test samples, exact match; self-consistency (8 samples, majority) filtered unlabeled training data; Distill 2-Step RaR
results.quote: we achieve a remarkable accuracy of 98.0%

results.claim: Unfiltered distillation of RaR gets 87.5% versus 98% filtered, so consistency filtering matters.
results.setup: Llama-2-70B-chat, last letter concatenation, 200 test samples, exact match; ablation without self-consistency filter
results.quote: it achieved an exact match accuracy of 87.5% (with 98% for the filtered version)

results.claim: Distilling System 1 predictions with the same filter gets 69.5%, so most of the 98% is not just task fine-tuning.
results.setup: Llama-2-70B-chat, last letter concatenation, 200 test samples, exact match; Distill System 1
results.quote: which results in a lower accuracy of 69.5%

results.claim: Distilling zero-shot CoT into System 1 on GSM8K gives 7.13% at k=1, against 52.77% for zero-shot CoT.
results.baseline_value: 52.77% (CoT zero-shot k=1); 7.58% (System 1 few-shot no CoT k=1)

results.note: Few-shot (8) System 1 without CoT scores 7.58% at k=1, so the distilled model is about at System 1 level. Text says only that distillation 'yields poor performance'.

limits: Only Llama-2-70B-chat tested; one base model, 2024-era
CoT on GSM8K did not distill (7.13% vs 52.77%); authors say it 'leaves room for future research to elucidate in exactly which circumstances to apply distillation'
Performance depends on the consistency filter; alternative curation strategies not explored
Distilled System 2 sometimes close to or above System 2 teacher, but Distill System 1 ablations show part of the gain is task fine-tuning (69.5% on last letter)
Few tasks, test sets small in places (200 last letter), single run except S2A; no variance reported
No code, weights or data release stated; optimizer, batch size, hardware, seq len not stated
Distillation data for RaR/S2A/BSM overlaps the task distribution of the eval (in-distribution for OASST2)
Coin flip: RaR relies on prompt engineering ('Flip means reverse') which the authors flag as a limitation

terms.definition: application of the Transformer to directly produce a response given an input, without generation of intermediate tokens
any approach which generates intermediate tokens, including methods that perform search, or prompt multiple times, before finally generating a response
fine-tuning System 1 to match the predictions of the System 2 method on a collected pool of consistent examples, without generating the intermediate steps
